description: This file defines the Java entity class 'TaxRateDescription' which represents language-specific descriptions associated with a 'TaxRate' in a sales management system. It maps to the 'TAX_RATE_DESCRIPTION' table in the database, including references to the tax rate and language identifiers.

classes.name: TaxRateDescription
classes.description: A JPA entity representing the description of a tax rate in different languages, extending the 'Description' class, mapped to 'TAX_RATE_DESCRIPTION' table with unique constraints on 'TAX_RATE_ID' and 'LANGUAGE_ID'.

methods.description: Default constructor for the TaxRateDescription entity.
